annotation.bound_parties_text: Pedestrians, drivers of motor vehicles or trams, riders of horses, outdoor mobile robot operators, caregivers of children, and Mayors/police authorities are bound by the Act.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Pedestrians who walk roads, drivers of motor vehicles or trams, and riders of horses that move along roads shall observe signals and instructions
annotation.dates_quote: This Act shall enter into force on January 1, 2026.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Article 8-2 (Obligations of outdoor mobile robot operator) ... [This Article Wholly Inserted on Apr. 18, 2023]
